ios.desc:
NEVER MISS A GIFT AGAIN
Gift List Planner & Tracker is the ultimate app for organizing all your gift-giving. Whether it's Christmas, birthdays, anniversaries, or any special occasion, keep track of gift ideas, purchases, and budgets all in one place.

◉ KEY FEATURES AT A GLANCE:

• Unlimited occasions, events and recipients
• Photo attachments for gifts and people
• Budget tracking
• Gift status tracking (4 stages)
• Professional PDF export
• Store link integration
• iCloud sync across devices
• Shopping mode for stores
• Progress tracking
• Notes and details
• Color theme manager
• Privacy-focused (no ads, no tracking)

◉ ORGANIZE BY OCCASION

• Create unlimited occasions (Christmas, birthdays, anniversaries, etc.)
• Set dates and budgets for each occasion
• Add photos and notes to remember details
• Track your progress with visual completion indicators

◉ MANAGE YOUR GIFT RECIPIENTS

• Add people with photos
• Track spending per person to stay on budget
• See gift history and ideas for each recipient
• Never duplicate gifts with complete tracking

◉ TRACK EVERY GIFT

• Save gift ideas with photos and prices
• Mark status: Idea, Purchased, Wrapped, or Gifted 
• Add store links for easy online shopping
• Track quantities and total costs automatically
• Add notes and details for each gift

◉ SMART BUDGET MANAGEMENT

• Budget automatically set by gift pricing
• Real-time spending tracking
• Visual progress bars
• See the remaining budget at a glance

◉ BEAUTIFUL PDF REPORTS

• Generate professional shopping lists
• Multiple layout options (list or table format)
• Filter by status (ideas only, purchased, people, etc.)
• Hide prices for surprise lists
• Include photos and store information
• Clickable store links in PDFs
• Summary pages with statistics
• Perfect for printing or sharing

◉ SHOPPING MODE

• Filter to show only incomplete gifts
• Compact layout for mobile shopping
• Quick status updates on the go
• Store links open directly in the browser

◉ ICLOUD SYNC

• Access your lists on all your devices
• Automatic backup and sync
• Share lists with family members
• Never lose your gift planning

◉ CUSTOMIZATION OPTIONS

• Reports sort people by name, spending, or gift count
• Flexible PDF export settings
• Save your preferred settings
• Dark mode support
• Color theme manager selector with syncing across devices
• Fetch name & image from URL for adding gifts to the occasion
• Choose to import the gift name and/or photo from website URL

◉ PERFECT FOR:

•
